changed: Run Cloud Drive on Windows on a small Cloud Files layer of TMA Cloud's own instead of the cloud-filter library
Ship only the icons the apps use, cutting the icon font in the web and desktop apps from 488 KB to 26 KB
Update `rustls-webpki`, `webpki-roots`, `webpki-root-certs` and `ctutils` for security advisories RUSTSEC-2026-0381, RUSTSEC-2026-0382, RUSTSEC-2026-0383 and RUSTSEC-2026-0385
removed: Remove the `pgboss` schema the Node.js server left in the database (migration `067_drop_pg_boss`)
fixed: Fix a file renamed while a program had it open not opening from the desktop app on Windows until the app was restarted
Fix a save to a file renamed while it was open creating a second file under the old name on Windows, now goes to the renamed file, which keeps its edit lock
Fix renames and new files in Cloud Drive folders first opened in File Explorer showing up only at the next full pass, up to 30 minutes later
Fix the filled star and shared icons drawing as outlines, so starred files looked unstarred
Fix saves refused by someone else's edit lock being recorded in the audit log with reason `stale_version`; they now have reason `locked` and say who is editing
Fix `processing_time_ms` being empty in every audit log entry
